description: This file defines functions to configure Vitest testing environment for extension memory testing, including loading include patterns from environment variables and creating a scoped Vitest configuration object.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns for tests from environment variable, defaults to process.env if none provided.

methods.name: export function createExtensionMemoryVitestConfig( createExtensionMemoryVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a Vitest configuration scoped for extension memory testing, using include patterns from environment or default roots.
